newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends up, mkt awaits mini-band drop.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends up, mkt awaits mini-band drop.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.01 percent to close at 1.0210 to the dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market, with players awaiting a new drop in the real-dollar mini-band in coming days, dealers said.
Dealers said the market is expecting for Friday the first decline this month in the real-dollar mini-band between 0.05 and 0.1 percent.
"The Central Bank sometimes takes advantage of days between holidays to change the mini-band," one trader said.
On Thursday, Brazil's financial markets will be closed due to municipal elections.
The current trade level was set on Monday between 1.021 and 1.026 reais per greenback.

A limited bank strike which began last Thursday contributed to slow the trade again. Some banks were unable to participate in the forex market because their back-offices were not operating, dealers said.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real ended steady at 1.0267 real per dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real fell 0.29 percent to close at 1.042 real per greenback, traders said.
